eval: (() => { const note = document.getElementById('joinNote').textContent; if (!note.includes('Ask the host for the password')) throw new Error('join note: ' + note); return 'the join screen asks for a password'; })()

(() => { const r = {error: document.getElementById('joinError').textContent, menuShown: !document.getElementById('overlay').hidden, rejoinsOnReload: JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('dp.join')).joined, focus: document.activeElement.id}; if (r.error !== 'Wrong password.' || r.menuShown || r.rejoinsOnReload || r.focus !== 'passwordInput') throw new Error('refused: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); return JSON.stringify(r); })()

(() => { const r = {host: dp.isHost, startShown: !document.getElementById('startBtn').hidden, joinInfo: document.getElementById('joinInfo').textContent, status: document.getElementById('menuStatus').textContent, errorShown: !document.getElementById('joinError').hidden}; if (r.host || r.startShown || r.errorShown || r.joinInfo !== 'Friends open this address and type the password' + location.origin + ' ' || !r.status.startsWith('Waiting for the host: whoever joins with the host password')) throw new Error('player: ' + JSON.stringify(r)); return JSON.stringify(r); })()
dp.fetchAllLogs().then((r) => { if (r.status !== 403) throw new Error('a player got the logs: ' + r.status); return 'everyone\'s logs, asked for by a player: ' + r.status; })

(() => { if (dp.me.name !== 'Friend' || dp.isHost) throw new Error('after the reload: ' + dp.me.name + ' host ' + dp.isHost); return 'a reloaded tab rejoined by itself, with the password it had: ' + dp.me.name; })()
sessionStorage.setItem('dp.join', JSON.stringify({name: 'Boss', joined: false})); location.reload(); 'reload, to join as the host'

dp.fetchAllLogs().then(async (r) => { const b = new Uint8Array(await r.arrayBuffer()); const out = {status: r.status, zip: b[0] === 80 && b[1] === 75, button: !document.getElementById('hostLogsBtn').hidden}; if (out.status !== 200 || !out.zip || !out.button) throw new Error('host logs: ' + JSON.stringify(out)); return JSON.stringify(out); })
